Do you have a passion for troubleshooting, repair, and equipment reliability? Join a hands-on technical team working with marine, radar and subsea systems.

On behalf of our client, MARPRO Group is looking for a skilled Technician for the office in Copenhagen and other company locations in central Zealand.

You will become part of a highly specialised organisation working with advanced maritime and electronic systems in a demanding operational environment. The team combines technical expertise, innovation and a strong sense of purpose to deliver reliable solutions where quality, precision and commitment are essential.

The job

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Technician to join a growing technical team supporting advanced marine and subsea solutions.

This is a role for a proactive technical professional who enjoys troubleshooting, maintaining, and improving complex systems. You will work with a broad range of technologies including subsea equipment, radar systems, automation, electrical installations, mechanical systems, and integrated vessel solutions.

As part of a team of experienced specialists, you will be involved in installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and technical support activities both at our facilities and on project sites. The role requires a practical mindset and the ability to independently identify issues and implement effective solutions.

You will be expected to take ownership of tasks, support project execution, and contribute with technical expertise across multiple disciplines. The position combines workshop-based activities in the Copenhagen area with project assignments and travel.

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious about technology, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is willing to go the extra mile to ensure successful project delivery.

People don't show up just to do a job. They show up because they have passion. We are looking for individuals with fire in their eyes and the right attitude.

Professional Qualifications

• Relevant technical education

• Minimum 5 years of experience working with technical systems

• Experience with troubleshooting, maintenance, installation and commissioning of technical equipment

• Valid driving license and willingness to travel up to 60 days per year

• Fluency in English, eligibility to work within the EU and ability to obtain EU security clearance

Personal characteristics

• Hands-on and motivated by solving technical challenges

• Works independently and takes ownership of tasks and projects

• Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills with a proactive mindset

• Comfortable working across electrical, mechanical, and automation disciplines

• Reliable, adaptable, and willing to go the extra mile to ensure successful project delivery

Our Client offers

• A competitive salary package aligned with experience and responsibilities.

• The opportunity to work with cutting‑edge technology and innovative systems.

• A professional environment with room to grow, develop and influence workflows.

• A supportive, collaborative team culture focused on high technical standards.

• Employment is subject to security clearance, ensuring a stable and trusted work setting

Application

The application process is handled by MARPRO Group. If you have any questions to this position, please contact MARPRO Group at +45 5370 0995.

If you are interested in the position, please upload a motivated application and an updated CV via the application button. You will receive a confirmation email from us. Please check your spam folder, if you have not received the confirmation within 10 minutes after applying, to ensure future communication.

We strongly encourage you to connect with MARPRO Group, to be considered for job openings that are not publicly listed. It is 100% free and confidential to join our talent pool and you can create your personal profile in few minutes.

We are your gateway to Maritime & Shipping talent. Whether you’re a maritime or logistics company seeking exceptional professionals or a skilled individual searching for the next career opportunity, we connect the right talent with the right employers. Our extensive network and industry-specific expertise ensure a seamless recruitment process, making us the preferred choice for Maritime & Shipping staffing solutions.

We have the full and exclusive mandate to all positions listed and all applications have to go via MARPRO Group.

_At AGC Biologics, we are constantly developing our manufacturing capabilities to support the delivery of life-changing biologics to patients worldwide. As our new OT Operations Specialist, you will play an important role in maintaining and improving the Operational Technology landscape that supports our GMP-regulated manufacturing environment.

You will work at the intersection of technology, manufacturing, and quality, ensuring that our systems are reliable, compliant, and ready to support future digitalization initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work with advanced manufacturing technologies while collaborating with experts across Automation, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and IT.

**A key role in our Operational Technology landscape

**As a OT Operations Specialist, you will help ensure stable and compliant manufacturing systems while supporting continuous improvements across our digital production environment.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

****Operational Technology

**

• Support and maintain OT infrastructure and manufacturing systems in a GMP-regulated production environment.

• Manage OT servers, virtualization platforms, industrial networks, and system integrations.

• Troubleshoot complex OT-related issues across manufacturing environments.

• Collaborate closely with Automation, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and IT teams to ensure reliable operations.

**GMP & Compliance

**

• Ensure OT systems remain compliant with GMP requirements and data integrity principles (ALCOA+).

• Drive and support Change Controls (CRs), Deviations, CAPAs, and Risk Assessments related to OT systems.

• Support audits, inspections, and periodic system reviews.

• Contribute to Computer System Validation (CSV) activities, including IQ/OQ documentation and execution.

**Digitalization & Integration

**

• Support integration between manufacturing systems and business systems.

• Participate in digitalization initiatives involving MES, Historian, SCADA, ERP, and related manufacturing platforms.

• Support industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA, Modbus, and Profinet.

• Drive continuous improvements and identify opportunities for automation and increased operational efficiency.

**Security & Lifecycle Management

**

• Support OT cybersecurity initiatives and contribute to maintaining a secure technology environment.

• Manage system lifecycle activities including upgrades, patching, backup, disaster recovery, and access management.

• Ensure systems remain secure, reliable, and inspection-ready.

**A collaborative environment with room to make an impact

**You will join a team where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are key parts of how we work. You will work closely with colleagues across different functions and act as a trusted technology partner to Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and IT.

Success in this role means maintaining a stable and compliant OT environment, driving GMP-related improvements, strengthening system integrations, and identifying opportunities where technology can improve our manufacturing processes.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings

**You have a strong interest in combining technology with manufacturing and thrive in an environment where quality, compliance, and reliability are essential.

**We Imagine That You Have

**

• A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Automation, Computer Science, or a similar field.

• 5+ years of experience within OT, Manufacturing IT, Automation, or Life Sciences.

• Strong understanding of GMP-regulated environments.

• Experience managing Change Controls, Deviations, CAPAs, and validation activities.

• Experience working with OT infrastructure, servers, virtualization, and industrial networking.

• Experience working with manufacturing systems such as SCADA, Historian, MES, or similar platforms.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

**It Is An Advantage If You Have Experience With

**

• MES platforms and manufacturing system integrations.

• APIs and data flows between systems.

• Industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, or Profinet.

• OT cybersecurity frameworks and best practices.

• Supporting FDA, EMA, or other regulatory inspections.

**Why join AGC Biologics?

**At AGC Biologics, you will have the opportunity to shape the future OT landscape and digital manufacturing strategy while working in a highly regulated and technologically advanced production environment.

You will collaborate with talented colleagues across a global organization where innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring reliable manufacturing processes that help bring important biologic therapies to patients worldwide.

**Join our team

**We are eager to welcome a new colleague as soon as possible. Please submit your application no later than 15 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

If you have any questions about the position, **please contact Jimmy Jespersen, Director of IT, at jimmy.jespersen@agc.com

**Please apply exclusively through our recruitment system. Applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To support an inclusive and unbiased recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your CV. At AGC Biologics, we are committed to fair hiring practices and value diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Context & Environment

Are you an experienced tax professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with practical business advice? Would you like to take ownership of corporate tax compliance while working across an international organisation?

We are looking for a Senior Tax Compliance Manager to join our Tax team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will oversee key corporate tax deliverables and provide hands-on tax support across the business, with a particular focus on corporate tax and its interaction with hydrocarbon tax. You will work closely with Finance, operational teams and our headquarters in Paris, while supporting projects and engaging regularly with the Danish tax authorities.

This is an opportunity to take on a visible and independent role where your expertise will contribute to sound decision-making, strong compliance and effective cooperation across the organisation.

Activities

Your key responsibilities

As Senior Tax Compliance Manager, you will:

• Provide hands-on tax support across a broad range of areas, with a focus on corporate tax and its interaction with hydrocarbon tax.

• Take ownership of corporate tax calculations for tax returns and tax reporting in the annual report.

• Drive ongoing compliance related to Pillar Two, country-by-country reporting and other recurring data submissions.

• Act as a regular point of contact with the Danish tax authorities.

• Handle authority queries and make decisions within the direction set by the Head of Tax.

• Monitor Danish tax legislation and assess the implications of regulatory developments for the company.

• Advise the business on the tax implications of projects and ad hoc matters.

• Connect the business with Finance, Tax and our headquarters in Paris.

• Cooperate with Finance and other teams to support tax compliance across the organisation.

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Total Rewards Package:

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 669.750 - 893.000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership program participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

Candidate Profile

You are a self-starter who works independently, takes responsibility and confidently leads assignments from analysis through to delivery.

You combine strong technical tax knowledge with commercial understanding and sound judgement. You are also able to explain complex tax matters clearly and translate regulatory requirements into practical actions for the business.

As the role involves cooperation with a wide range of stakeholders, you should be comfortable building relationships across different functions, cultures and organisational levels.

Your background

We expect that you have:

• At least five years of experience in a comparable tax role.

• A professional background as a lawyer, chartered accountant, tax adviser or equivalent.

• A relevant college or university degree, or equivalent professional experience.

• Strong knowledge of corporate tax and tax compliance.

• Experience managing important deliverables and working independently.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Experience from an accounting or law firm will be considered an advantage.

Contacts:

For questions regarding the position, please contact:

• Position-related questions: Head of Tax Susi BAERENTZEN at susi.baerentzen@totalenergies.com

• HR-related questions: Talent Developer Gulmaral BOKAYEVA at Gulmaral.Bokayeva@totalenergies.com

We look forward to receiving your application.

Application deadline: 11 November 2026

Additional Information

About TotalEnergies in Denmark

TotalEnergies is among Denmark's leading energy companies and has been active in the country for more than 50 years. With approximately 1,000 employees based in Esbjerg, Copenhagen and offshore locations, the Company makes a significant contribution to Denmark's energy supply, economy and employment. TotalEnergies operates the Danish Underground Consortium (“DUC”) with a 43.2% share together with partners BlueNord (36.8%) and state-owned Nordsøfonden (20%), producing more than 80% of the oil and 90% of the gas in the Danish North Sea. The Company also sells lubricants, bitumen, special fluids and biofuels to the industrial and automotive markets. As an integrated energy company, TotalEnergies is exploring opportunities in offshore wind and developing a Carbon Capture & Storage (CCS) business in support of Denmark and Europe's decarbonization and climate targets, holding three offshore CO₂ storage licenses in the Danish North Sea.

About TotalEnergies

TotalEnergies is a global integrated energy company that produces and markets energies: oil and biofuels, natural gas, biogas and low-carbon hydrogen, renewables and electricity. Our more than 100,000 employees are committed to provide as many people as possible with energy that is more reliable, more affordable and more sustainable. Active in about 120 countries, TotalEnergies places sustainability at the heart of its strategy, its projects and its operations.

Context & Environment

Application deadline: 11-11-2026

Contract type: Local, Esbjerg

Appetizer

Do you want to turn cybersecurity requirements into clear governance that people can actually follow? Are you excited by the challenge of protecting both enterprise and industrial environments? Do you enjoy partnering with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and driving risk-reducing actions through to completion? In this role, you will help implement cybersecurity policies and governance, ensuring compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements. If this sounds like the kind of impact you want to make, apply now and tell us what you would bring to the team.

Your new team

One IT Denmark delivers the IT and digital services that keep the business running onshore and offshore. We work closely with colleagues across the organization to improve reliability, introduce new solutions, and strengthen cybersecurity.

The department includes four teams: Business Partnering, IT Operations, Project & Performance, and Cybersecurity & Industrial. Together, we support TotalEnergies EP Denmark (TEPDK) and TotalEnergies Upstream Denmark (TUDK) operations and development projects.

In a department with different nationalities and backgrounds, we believe in the power of diversity and collaboration. People are the key to our success; we invest in development and foster an atmosphere of innovation.

Would you like to help shape better energy?

Send your application as soon as possible. For any questions, you are more than welcome to reach out to Human Resources (HR) Recruitment on ep.dk-recruitment@totalenergies.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Activities

Operational procedures and security

• Help define and improve security procedures and technical controls (hardware and software) to reduce risk

• Strengthen incident readiness and response by helping define roles, playbooks, tooling, training and supporting response activities during major incidents

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

**_Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

_**As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To

****Technical Leadership

**

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

**Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

**

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

**AI Services & Agentic Development

**

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

**CI/CD & Reliability

**

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

**Job Requirements

****Education & Experience

**

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

**Technical Skills

**

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

**Soft Skills

**Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

**About The Team

**You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Weibel, you will join a rapidly growing, family-owned technology company where curiosity, innovation, and dedication form the foundation of our success. As our new Sub System Architect you will play a key role in shaping the design of our radar solutions. You will work alongside talented, committed colleagues who share a passion for technology.

We are expanding our team and are looking for a Sub System Architect to lead the architecture of key subsystems e.g., pedestals, trailers, cooling, or power from concept to verification. You will translate system needs into robust solutions, interfaces, and guide cross‑disciplinary design through specification, reviews, integration, and test. Verifying and developing designs is done by review, simulations, and prototyping.

Your impact

• Be responsible for the subsystem architecture: define purpose, scope, block diagrams, interfaces, BOM structure, and key design decisions.

• Requirements flow‑down & compliance: allocate system requirements to subsystem level, maintain compliance matrices/SoC, and support traceability through design, test, and verification.

• Interface leadership: specify and manage interfaces to neighboring subsystems and external equipment and ensure early alignment.

• Design coordination: collaborate with engineering disciplines Mechanical, Electrical and Software, to meet performance, reliability, maintainability, and safety requirements.

• Risk & change control: identify technical risks, propose mitigations, and manage changes while safeguarding architectural integrity.

• Integration & verification: support build, bring-up, test planning, environmental testing (shock, vibration, thermal), and verification reports.

• Reviews & communication: prepare architecture packages and lead design reviews. Communicate decisions and rationales to stakeholders, and ensure documentation is clear and ready for review.

Your background and experience

• BSc/MSc in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or similar.

• Solid systems engineering mindset and preferably a few years of experience from a similar role.

• Experience with functional decomposition, interfaces, requirements, verification/validation, and standards.

• Ability to create clear technical documentation and lead collaborative reviews.

Your new team

In our R&D department you will join more than 270 highly competent and dedicated colleagues. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do, ensuring a seamless transition from design to production. We are dedicated to the ongoing refinement of our processes and the strategic integration of new technologies. We wholeheartedly believe that bringing people with different competencies together will generate the best solutions.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. The application can be in Danish or English. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Director, Hans Plessing on hap@weibel.dk

The deadline is 16th of November 2026, but we review the applications on an ongoing basis.

Please be aware that it is a requirement for this position that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain a security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Bliv en del af en dansk virksomhed

Weibel Scientific A/S er en danskejet ingeniørvirksomhed i kraftig vækst. Vi udvikler og producerer højteknologiske radarer til brug i bl.a. rumforskning, flyindustri, forsvar samt beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur. Vi er verdensførende inden for udvikling af Doppler-radarer og har siden vores etablering i 1977 leveret flere end 4.500 state-of-the art radarer til mere end 40 lande.

Vores hovedkvarter ligger i Allerød og beskæftiger knap 600 medarbejdere.

I Weibel kan du se frem til et spændende og udfordrende job i en dynamisk og fremtidsorienteret virksomhed med in-house produktion og højteknologisk udvikling.

Læs også meget mere om os på vores hjemmeside.

jobs.occupation: PROJECT MANAGER FOR REAL ESTATE & FACILITY MANAGEMENT
jobs.description:
Project Manager for Real Estate and Facility Management

Join SAS on an Exciting Journey as a Project Manager for Real Estate & Facility Management

As Project Manager Real Estate & Facility Management at SAS, you will be responsible for leading and delivering real estate, workplace, refurbishment, and construction projects across Copenhagen and Copenhagen Airport. You will manage projects from concept and planning through execution and handover, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and according to business requirements.

Working closely with SAS Head of Real Estate, service partners, landlords, airport authorities, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in developing and transforming SAS real estate portfolio.

The role acts as the primary project lead and local REFM representative in Copenhagen, serving as the central point of coordination between stakeholders, suppliers, airport authorities, and the wider REFM organization.

Challenges you will work on:

Project Management & Delivery

• Lead workplace, refurbishment, construction, and facility-related projects across SAS locations in Copenhagen and Copenhagen Airport.

• Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

• Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and business requirements.

• Prepare project plans, business cases, progress reports, and decision-making material for stakeholders and management.

Construction & Technical Projects

• Coordinate and manage consultants, architects, contractors, and other external project resources.

• Oversee construction activities, site inspections, and project implementation.

• Ensure compliance with Danish construction regulations, airport requirements, health and safety standards, and internal governance.

• Review technical solutions, drawings, project documentation, and contractor deliverables.

Stakeholder & Supplier Management

• Act as the primary local point of contact for project-related REFM activities in Copenhagen.

• Coordinate project activities with landlords, airport authorities, suppliers, consultants, and internal business stakeholders.

• Build and maintain strong relationships to ensure alignment, support, and successful project execution.

• Lead project meetings and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to relevant stakeholders.

Financial & Commercial Management

• Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts, and cost follow-up.

• Support procurement activities, tender processes, and contract negotiations.

• Monitor project costs and identify opportunities for value engineering and cost optimization.

• Manage project changes, variations, and commercial discussions with suppliers and contractors.

Portfolio Development & Workplace Improvements

• Support the development and execution of the REFM project portfolio in Copenhagen.

• Drive workplace improvements, office transformations, and facility upgrades that enhance employee experience and operational efficiency.

• Identify opportunities to improve space utilization, sustainability performance, and overall workplace functionality.

• Contribute to strategic real estate and facility initiatives across the SAS portfolio.

The Team

You will be part of the SAS Real Estate & Facility Management (REFM) organization, collaborating with colleagues across Scandinavia to develop and deliver workplace, facility, and real estate projects that support both employees and business objectives.

SAS REFM manages approximately 260,000 sqm of leased and owned space, overseeing workplace services, lease agreements, renovations, construction projects, facility operations, and stakeholder relations. Our ambition is to provide sustainable, cost-effective, and attractive workplaces while supporting SAS's strategic development and operational needs.

As part of a close-knit Scandinavian team, you will work across borders and functions, leading projects and contributing to the development of workplaces and facilities that support the future of SAS.

To be successful we believe you have

• 5+ years of experience within project management, construction, real estate, facility management, workplace development.

• Relevant education within Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Real Estate, Facility Management, or equivalent.

• Proven experience managing construction, fit-out, refurbishment, workplace, or facility projects from planning through execution.

• Strong understanding of construction processes, project governance, procurement, and contract management.

• Experience managing contractors, consultants, suppliers, and multiple stakeholders simultaneously.

• Knowledge of Danish construction regulations, building standards, and health and safety requirements.

• Experience from an airport, transportation, logistics, property, or another complex operational environment is an advantage.

• Strong financial understanding with experience managing project budgets, forecasts, and cost control.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.

• A proactive, structured, and solution-oriented mindset with strong leadership capabilities.

• Excellent communication skills in English and Danish. Swedish is an advantage.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools.

• Ability to work independently while driving multiple projects in a dynamic environment.

• Proven relationship-building skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.

• A high level of ownership, commercial awareness, and commitment to delivering results.

jobs.occupation: Drive Technical Excellence, Lead with Confidence, and Make an Impact as Team Lead for our Hardware Automation team
jobs.description:
Are you a technically strong and decisive leader who sets high standards, takes ownership, and drives results?
At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a Team Lead – Hardware, Automation who combines solid electrical engineering expertise with a strong leadership presence and the determination to make things happen.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their technical decisions, comfortable taking responsibility, and motivated by delivering high-quality results. Someone who brings structure, challenges the status quo when needed, and has the courage to set clear expectations and follow through.

In this role, you will lead our Hardware Team within the Automation department, ensuring that we deliver safe, reliable, and production-ready electrical hardware solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you will combine technical expertise with team leadership. Approximately 80% of your time will be dedicated to technical and operational activities, while 20% will focus on leadership, planning, and employee development.
Your role – technical excellence meets strong leadership
As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.
Your key responsibilities
• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.
• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.
• Drive standardization and engineering automation: Develop and implement standardized electrical designs, components, and documentation practices. Promote automated generation of electrical drawings to reduce manual engineering effort, improve consistency, and increase efficiency.
• Focus on cost optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through smarter design solutions, component standardization, efficient engineering processes, and close collaboration with Procurement and Production, without compromising safety, quality, or reliability.
• Take ownership of planning and delivery: Allocate resources, monitor capacity and progress, address obstacles, and proactively manage delivery risks.
• Make sound technical decisions: Evaluate complex engineering challenges, balance quality, cost, safety, and delivery requirements, and make well-founded decisions, even under pressure.
• Develop and challenge your team: Provide constructive feedback, coach employees, encourage accountability, and support the development of technical competencies.
• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and panel builders to resolve issues and ensure effective project execution.
• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve standards, processes, tools, and working methods, and take the initiative to turn improvements into measurable results.What we are looking for
We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional with a strong technical foundation and a natural ability to take the lead.

You enjoy responsibility, have a structured and analytical approach, and are comfortable making decisions and standing behind them.

Ideally, you bring:

• A relevant technical or engineering background within electrical engineering, automation, or a related field.
• Solid experience with electrical design and panel engineering for industrial machinery.
• Strong knowledge of electrical safety, technical standards, and regulatory requirements, including CE and DS/EN/IEC 60204-1.
• Experience with electrical components, BOM structures, technical documentation, and engineering standards.
• A strong understanding of standardization and an interest in automated engineering processes, including automated generation of electrical drawings.
• A commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost optimization opportunities while maintaining technical quality and compliance.
• The ability to analyze complex technical challenges and make clear, well-founded decisions.
• Experience coordinating technical work, managing priorities, and ensuring delivery against commitments.
• Previous experience in technical leadership, team coordination, or people management, or demonstrated leadership potential combined with a strong desire to take responsibility.Your personality makes the difference
For this position, your personal drive and leadership approach are just as important as your technical qualifications.

We are looking for someone who brings a strong personality, clear direction, and high professional standards to the team.

You are likely to recognize yourself in the following:

• Decisive and confident: You are comfortable taking the lead, making decisions, and addressing challenges directly rather than waiting for others to act.
• Analytical and detail-oriented: You approach technical challenges systematically, question assumptions, and base your decisions on facts and sound engineering judgment.
• Results-driven and accountable: You set ambitious but realistic expectations, take ownership, and follow through to ensure that objectives are achieved.
• Structured and quality-conscious: You value precision, consistency, and well-defined processes and are unwilling to compromise on safety or critical quality requirements.
• Assertive and constructive: You are willing to challenge ideas, address difficult issues, and stand by your professional assessments while respecting different perspectives.
• Demanding but supportive: You set high standards for yourself and others, provide clear feedback, and help your team develop the skills and confidence to succeed.
• Proactive and improvement-oriented: You identify opportunities, challenge inefficient ways of working, and drive improvements that increase efficiency, standardization, and cost competitiveness.
You have the confidence to lead experienced technical specialists, the credibility to earn their respect, and the ability to create an environment where clear expectations, professional discussions, and shared accountability lead to strong results.
What you can expect from us
At Gram Equipment, you will have the opportunity to combine your technical expertise with leadership responsibility in an engineering environment where quality, reliability, and continuous improvement are essential.

You can look forward to:

• A challenging and varied role combining hands-on engineering with people leadership.
• Responsibility for a team of skilled technical specialists.
• The opportunity to influence technical decisions, engineering standards, and ways of working.
• The opportunity to drive standardization, engineering automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
• Close collaboration across engineering disciplines and other business functions.
• The opportunity to make a visible impact on team performance, technical quality, and project delivery.
• A working environment that values ownership, professional expertise, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• A flexible working approach, with the position primarily based in Kolding and opportunities for hybrid working.Ready to take ownership and make a difference?
If you are a technically strong engineer who enjoys taking the lead, making decisions, and driving high standards while improving engineering efficiency and cost competitiveness, this could be your next career opportunity.

Join Gram Equipment and take the lead in developing our Hardware Team and delivering high-quality, efficient, and competitive automation solutions.
